fields.description: Show the Layby button on Point of Sale.

fields.label: Minimum Deposit %

fields.description: Days from opening date until the layby must be completed.

fields.description: Extra days after due date before a layby is flagged overdue.

fields.description: Customer cancel within this many days of opening receives a full deposit refund.

fields.description: Deposit refund percentage when the customer cancels after the early window.
fields.label: Late Cancel Refund %

fields.description: Receipts older than this cannot be returned (store credit). Cashiers still see them in search until Receipt Search Window.
fields.label: Return Acceptance (Days)

fields.description: How far back Returns & Store Credit lists paid receipts for this store. Must be at least Return Acceptance (Days).
fields.label: Receipt Search Window (Days)

fields.description: Customer copy — deposit, paid amount, balance, items. Used when opening a layby and recording payments.
fields.label: Layby Customer Print Format

fields.label: Layby Reserve Print Format

fields.description: Final receipt when the layby is fully paid. DocType should be Sales Invoice.

fields.description: Open the print dialog automatically after collecting an account payment at the till (Customer Account → Pay).
